metadata.name: GetBillingTableByProduct
metadata.description: This API is to get the Billing table list defined for a Merchant.

request_fields.description: Source of API Consumer For external system expected sources will be WEB. Allowable Values: 50

request_fields.name: DateFormat

children.name: GetBillingTableList
children.description: List of  of Billing table defined on the Merchant. Example:abc_FICO_620_629

children.name: BillingTableID
children.description: Unique ID of Billing table defined while configuring the product. Valid Values:0-9 Format:XXXX Example:12

children.name: BillingTableName
children.description: Name of Billing table defined while configuring the product. Valid Values:0-9, A-Z Format:XXXX Example:abc_FICO_620_629 Allowable Values: 100

children.name: IsDefault
children.description: This tag tell that the Billing table is default for the Merchant Valid Values:Y/N Format:X Example:Y/N

children.name: PIIRequired
children.description: Indicates if PII (personal identification information) is required or not for this product Valid Values: 1 - No, 0 - Yes Format: X Example: 1
